summary: Kootenai NF L-4 cab built 1931, staffed until 1942, destroyed 1977; FFLA list marks it gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1977 according to the firelookout.com page; the FFLA Montana list marks it gone. No source describes what remains at the site today

events.note: L-4 cab built in 1931, per firelookout.com page
Ultimately destroyed in 1977, per firelookout.com page; cause not given

notes_for_editor: Build, staffing and destruction years rest on one page (firelookout.com); the FFLA list agrees on Ground and gone. The Lincoln County Forest Lookouts page gives the name Poorman Mountain with no history text; it is cited only for that name and was not used for any date. The cause of the 1977 destruction is not in any source read. The FFLA list position (48.97609, -114.92879) is not checked against the 'eight miles NNE of Eureka' description; an editor may want to compare them. Photo on the firelookout.com page is credited to the Fire Lookout Museum with no image URL, so no photos are listed. Elevation is in feet from the source; the record's elevation_m is null. Read budget went over the per-tower guide because sources are thin. WebSearch used twice.
